description: This file defines the NsdHelper class, which encapsulates the functionality for managing network service discovery (NSD) in an Android application. It handles initializing discovery, resolution, registration, and teardown of network services, providing a simplified API for service discovery over TCP/IP networks.

classes.name: NsdHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing Android network service discovery (NSD), including service registration, discovery, resolution, and teardown.

methods.name: NsdHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NSD helper with the application context.

methods.name: initializeNsd
methods.description: Sets up the resolve listener required for resolving service info discovered on the network.

methods.name: initializeDiscoveryListener
methods.description: Creates and assigns a discovery listener to handle NSD discovery events such as service found, lost, start, and stop.

methods.name: initializeResolveListener
methods.description: Creates and assigns a resolve listener to handle the success or failure of resolving service info.

methods.name: initializeRegistrationListener
methods.description: Creates and assigns a registration listener to handle service registration events.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a network service on the specified port with the NSD system.

methods.name: discoverServices
methods.description: Starts discovery of available network services matching the SERVICE_TYPE.

methods.name: getChosenServiceInfo
methods.description: Returns the currently resolved service information.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Unregisters any registered service and cleans up resources.
